root_cause: Babel Codex CLI 0.154 requires a codex-linux-sandbox argv0 alias. The first two jobs had no alias; the third provided it on the host but the controlled Bubblewrap filesystem did not mount the job-local helper directory. The worker could not run shell commands, inspect task data, or write required outputs.
recovery: Create the alias only inside each Slurm job temporary directory and mount its directory plus resolved binary read-only in the controlled scientific filesystem. Provider-free job 10488117 executed a sandboxed shell command successfully; focused job 10488171 passed 30 tests.
